672: A samurai living in an era where a samurai is no longer needed. To add to his troubles, oppressive aliens have moved in to invade. Gintoki lives with Kagura and Shinpachi, taking on odd jobs to make the world a better place...and to pay their rent.
673: Shinpachi Shimura works under Gintoki to learn the ways of the samurai. He used to stay at his family's dōjo. However, it seems more like he's just trying to help Gintoki pay the rent than to learn. Shinpachi is the captain of the "Otsu's Imperial Guard," a pop singer's fan club.
674: Although she appears to be a normal, cute, human girl in Chinese-style clothing, she actually belongs to the Yato Clan, one of the strongest and most bloodthirsty of the Amanto races.
2946: Elizabeth resembles a giant white duck or a giant penguin and is Katsura's companion. Elizabeth was a present from Tatsuma Sakamoto, who presumably picked it up on his travels around space.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
90107: Kusuo Saiki has an extremely uncaring, neutral personality.
90108: Nendo has a simple way of thinking, but because of it, Saiki is unable to read his mind. Because Saiki is unable to detect Nendo's presence, Nendo is the only person who is able to sneak up on Saiki and making him think he will someday be a dangerous foe.
90109: Kokomi Teruhashi is a student in Kusuo's class, considered very attractive by both women and men, who often stop and stare upon seeing her.
90110: Kuniharu Saiki is the father of Kusuo and Kusuke and the husband of Kurumi.
90111: Another psychic and one of two people outside of Saiki's family to know of his abilities. He has the ability to see spirits and is haunted by the ghost of Nendou's late father, but is only interested in using his ability to attract girls.
90112: Shun is a young man who considers himself to be the "Jet-Black Wing", a lone hero fighting against the evil organization Dark Reunion. He also believes his powers stem from a dark being living within his arm.
90113: Kurumi Saiki is Saiki's lovely mother.
90114: An overly hot-blooded, energetic, passionate student who enjoys sports and is constantly trying to get other people motivated. He is also Saiki's class representative, but due to his nature, he is well-trusted by his classmates.
90115: A romantic and dreamy girl who easily falls in love with boys. She originally has a crush on Kusuo and tried her best to appeal to Kusuo. Kusuo in turn rejected her as hard as he could with his PSI powers.
125796: Chisato Mera is a classmate of Kusuo's. She works part time in Cafe Mami as a waitress.
126506: Kusuke is Kusuo's older brother and a super genius who likes to invent machines/devices. Kusuke is prideful and competitive when it comes to Kusuo. He would have done anything to win against him when they were kids, but he would always lose against his little brother.
126507: Aiura is a gyaru soothsayer, or someone who is able to foresee the future. She is another love-interest of Kusuo's and transfers to PK Academy upon reading her own fortune and learning that her "Mr. Right" would be there.
126857: Touma Akechi, used to be a classmate and one of the very first friends Kusuo had in Kindergarten. He is a 3rd student in PK Academy that knows of Kusuo's powers.
127131: Anpu shows up a couple of times and is also part of the “everyone else loves me so why doesn’t Saiki” brigade. After being saved by Kusuo, he starts to visit his house to make Kusuo pet him. He once got Kusuo (disguised as Sai) to aid him in trying to woo a female cat Pushi.
127132: He was first introduced as Michael (Mr. Ike) by Uryoku when Kusuo runs into them performing a street show. After failing their act, Ike wasn't given the money he was promised because they didn't earn anything from passersby. He continued to be Uryoku's assistant afterwards.
127133: He's a homeless magician that first appeared playing tricks in the street with his partner Michael. Basically Chouno goes in and out of being a homeless failure and a semi-successful magician.
127134: Kuboyasu in his previous school wore the typical delinquent clothes. He sported a pompadour hairstyle, and wore a modified school uniform with his pants looking more like an over-sized skirt.
127277: A top idol and Kokomi's older brother. He has a serious sister complex and hates it when Saiki is near her.
133550: Metori Saiko is the scion of the top-notch Saiko Conglomerate. He later transfers to PK Academy after falling in love with Kokomi when he was in the city. His defining traits are being rich and smug.
148959: Hii Suzumiya is a new transfer student in Toritsuka Reita's class.
158250: Kumagoro Saiki is the husband of Kumi Saiki, the father of Kurumi, the father-in-law of Kuniharu Saiki and grandfather of Kusuo Saiki and Kusuke Saiki. Kumagoro is a grumpy old man who hates Kusuo's father Kuniharu and loves his daughter Kurumi.
158251: Kumi Saiki is the wife of Kumagoro Saiki, Kurumi Saiki's mother, the mother-in-law of Kuniharu Saiki, and grandmother of Kusuo Saiki and Kusuke Saiki.
218187: A neighborhood boy. He first met Saiki Kusuo after his balloon got blown up high and the latter caught it for him. He got attached to Kusuo and Kokomi in the later chapters. He is one of the few aware that Saiki has powers, but doesn't know he's a psychic.
219253: Hiroshi Satou is from the same class as Reita. He is the epitome of an ultimate normal guy, everything that Kusuo has ever wanted to be. Hiroshi was first introduced as someone who gets the same rank in school as Kusuo.
220232: A member of the Tennis Club which Kineshi is also a member of. Toritsuka flirted with her with the help of Kineshi and Saiki, however she wasn't amazed with Toritsuka's abilities in tennis and was thus cold towards him.
225123: Imu is a popular 1st year girl in PK Academy. She possesses a similar charm to Teruhashi, but is continuously outshined by her.
225401: PK Academy's gym teacher and guidance counselor.
304713: A robotic cat created by Kusuke for Kusuo's parents' 22nd anniversary, due to Kurumi having a cat allergy. Has many features, such as an alarm, camera, web browser, etc.
358989: Baiku Manabe is a motorcycle instructor at the JET driving school. He often uses the phrase "B. K. B." This is a reference to Fumitaka Kawasaki, who is his Japanese voice actor, as well as a comedian known for using this phrase in his routine.
